title: Social micro-breaks
intro: Small, friendly moments, only if you feel like it. Quiet is always an option too.

prompts.text: Say hello to someone you pass. A smile counts.
Send a short, kind message to someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Ask someone nearby how their day is going, and give the answer your full attention.
Thank someone for something small they did.
Offer to make someone a drink while you are up.
Share something small that made you smile today.
Wave to a neighbour or colleague you can see.
Ask a friendly question about the weekend, a hobby or a pet.
Hold the door and say good morning, afternoon or evening.
No chat today? Sit quietly for a minute. That is a fine break too.
Pay someone a small, sincere compliment.

backAtDesk: Welcome back. Whether you chatted or not, that was a good break.
